The skin smells faintly of burnt almonds or cut grass.Respiratory/Systemic: Shortness of breath, mild tachypnea, and sudden, severe muscle twitching (fasciculations) that began 10 minutes post-exposure.Operational Constraint:Standard advanced diagnostics are unavailable. The primary treatment kit contains standard trauma items, atropine/pralidoxime (2-PAM) autoinjectors, sodium thiosulfate, hydroxycobalamin, and basic field-expedient wellness supplies.Scan Instructions:Run a single scan over the medical and toxicological corpus to map this multi-system presentation.
